data_objects.name: sparse_feature_vectors
data_objects.meaning: Record identifiers paired with comma-separated sparse numeric key:value feature vectors.

data_objects.name: feature_name_mapping
data_objects.meaning: Partial lookup from Column_N feature names to opaque source-detail codes.

variables.name: kv_features
variables.meaning: Sparse feature vector serialized as comma-separated integer_key:numeric_value pairs; rows may contain no pairs.

variables.name: feature_name
variables.meaning: Feature name formatted as Column_N; N corresponds to an integer key in kv_features.

variables.name: detail
variables.meaning: Opaque source feature code associated one-to-one with feature_name, such as SC_C... or var....

structure.description: The integer key N in input_1.csv can be linked to input_2.csv through feature_name = Column_N. The mapping covers only a subset of keys present in the sparse vectors.

uncertainties: The meaning and units of feature values and opaque detail codes are not documented.
Many sparse-vector keys have no row in the supplied mapping table.
annotation_notes: An absent key in a sparse row is different from a present key with value zero.
Parse kv_features on commas and then split each pair at its first colon.
